responsibility: Implements the Fortran-specific libcpp integration used for preprocessing and preprocessed-output generation. It parses deferred preprocessor options, defines Fortran and target builtin macros, queues and dumps macro changes, forwards diagnostics from cpp into gfortran's diagnostic machinery, and provides callbacks that control include, pragma, and line-directive emission.
same_name_distinction: Contains the libcpp-facing implementation for Fortran preprocessing, including builtin macro setup, deferred option handling, dependency/macro dumping, and diagnostic and line-control callbacks. Unlike gcc/fortran/cpp.h, it performs preprocessing integration rather than merely declaring the control entry points.
